ideas.pitch: A predictive web platform that forecasts harmful algal bloom risks in local water bodies 3-5 days in advance using machine learning.
ideas.title: AquaPredict Burgas: Algal Bloom Early Warning
ideas.why_it_could_win: Matches the proven pattern of winning the AquaSense IoT Hackathon with clear measurable environmental impact and predictive modeling.

ideas.pitch: A multilingual AI voice chatbot designed for semi-urban populations providing preventive care information, vaccination schedules, and symptom checks.
ideas.title: ArogyaVani: Multilingual Rural Health Copilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly builds on a proven 1st-prize-winning architecture that addresses critical community health education barriers in local languages.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite monitoring tool that automatically flags industrial land use violations and environmental non-compliance for local regulators.
ideas.title: EcoAudit AI: Industrial Land Compliance Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates a runner-up hackathon strategy combining high-impact geospatial data with practical regulatory workflows.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision pipeline that detects railway track surface defects and obstacles to prevent infrastructural accidents.
ideas.title: RailInspect Vision: Track Defect Detection
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors a runner-up win at an industrial hackathon by solving a high-stakes safety problem with a working computer vision model.

ideas.pitch: An interactive civic engagement dashboard that aggregates citizen reports via AI summaries and routes them directly to local municipal authorities.
ideas.title: CivicPulse: Local Council Feedback Dashboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the winning formula of real-time municipal dashboards and civic tech integration that judges at community-focused hackathons prioritize.
